title: Lit3R: Retrieve-Relate-Read for Evidence-Grounded Question Answering over Scientific Literature
abstract: arXiv:2609.16912v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We describe tus-nlp's Lit3R (Retrieve-Relate-Read) system for LitTraceQA, a shared task for literature-grounded question answering that requires systems to retrieve relevant papers, identify supporting evidence, and generate answers. Lit3R combines off-the-shelf retrieval, reranking, and large language model (LLM) components without task-specific training. The retriever iteratively combines BM25-based sparse and dense retrieval, cross-encoder reranking, and LLM-based verification, and complements retrieval based on the question with paper-to-paper expansion. The reader first identifies supporting evidence within individual papers and then synthesizes evidence across papers to produce the final answer and evidence trace. On the official test set, our system ranked 4th on the leaderboard. Our code is available at https://github.com/tus-ist-nlp/littraceqa.

translated_title: Lit3R：面向科学文献证据支持型问答的检索-关联-阅读系统
translated_abstract: 我们介绍了tus-nlp团队为LitTraceQA共享任务开发的Lit3R（Retrieve-Relate-Read，检索-关联-阅读）系统。LitTraceQA是一项基于文献的问答共享任务，要求系统检索相关论文、识别支持性证据并生成答案。Lit3R将现成的检索、重排序和大语言模型（LLM）组件相结合，无需针对特定任务进行训练。检索器迭代地结合基于BM25的稀疏检索与稠密检索、交叉编码器重排序以及基于LLM的验证，并通过论文间扩展来补充基于问题的检索。阅读器首先在单篇论文内识别支持性证据，随后综合跨论文的证据以生成最终答案和证据轨迹。在官方测试集上，我们的系统在排行榜上排名第4。我们的代码已在https://github.com/tus-ist-nlp/littraceqa开源。
tldr: Lit3R是一个无需任务特定训练的文献问答系统，通过迭代结合稀疏/稠密检索、重排序与LLM验证，并辅以论文间扩展和先篇内后跨篇的证据综合策略，在LitTraceQA排行榜上取得第4名。
en_tdlr: Lit3R is a training-free system that iteratively combines sparse and dense retrieval, cross-encoder reranking, LLM verification, and paper-to-paper expansion, synthesizing evidence within and across papers to achieve 4th place on the LitTraceQA leaderboard.
